Delhi Police Detain Activists at Jantar Mantar

Delhi Police detained activists Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, associated with the CJP (Citizens for Justice and Peace), at Jantar Mantar. The activists were reportedly holding a Tiranga (national flag) and chanting slogans. Police stated the action was taken due to security reasons and violation of Section 163 regulations in the area. Another CJP leader, Abhijit Dipke, was also mentioned in relation to the detentions. One report noted that the activists had previously evaded police at the Jantar Mantar site.
